items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was Eddie Marshall, James Leary, and Mark Levine on piano. ... It was a good band.

ctx.x: It was Eddie Marshall, James Leary, and Mark Levine on piano. Mark Levine, and me, Eddie, and Julian Priester in front. It was a good band. Played Maiden Voyage, played Dolphin Dance, played originals of Eddie’s. I was working with jazz musicians in San Francisco. I was accepted all right. They knew me, of course, because I had been at the Keystone Korner a million times by then. It worked and it worked and worked until Chick called me, and I went on the world tour.
